It occurs when the body's blood sugar drops below the normal range, often due to factors like excessive insulin, missed meals, or certain medical conditions. This condition is commonly experienced by individuals with diabetes who are on insulin or glucose-lowering medications. The cornus officinalis plant has been studied for its potential to lower blood sugar, offering a natural support for managing this condition.

Together, they support metabolic health and regulate blood glucose levels. Regular consumption of Cornus officinalis may contribute to better glycemic control in individuals with diabetes.

Cornus officinalis has been found to reduce oxidative stress by enhancing the body's antioxidant defenses.
